title: 9.6 Velocity and Acceleration

icans: I can find velocity and acceleration vectors from a position vector.
I can find the speed of a particle.
I can use F = ma to find the force on a moving object.

blocks.p: Draw the circle, the velocity, and the acceleration.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: r(t) = ⟨t³ − 3t, t² + t⟩. Find v(1) and a(1).

notes: Speed: speed = _______________, a number, not a vector.

blocks.stem: r(t) = ⟨3t², 8t⟩. Find the speed at t = 1.
r(t) = ⟨2 sin t, 3 cos t⟩. Find the speed at t = π/2.
